notes.title: Trivia Night 0.2 Update Released! New Game Modes, Turkish Language and more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i68.tinypic.com/f0tdw5.png[/img]

[h1]What's New[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Math[/b] game mode!
[*][b]Words[/b] game mode! (Online)
[*]Language screen and Turkish language.
[*]New questions added.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Red screen problem fixed.
[*]Fun with flags menu button fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[*]Game architecture set to 64bit.
[*]Some answers changed.
[*]Menu UI color changed.
[*]Answer button color changed.
[*]Few sound changes.
[*]Few typo fixes.
[*]Removed fun with flags score limit.

notes.title: Early Access Notes - Week 1
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/GsBcZjc.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Thank you all for interest in our first week. We're following your comments, feedbacks. You should know we're indie developers and Trivia Night is in Early Access Alpha right now.

But you can be sure we're planning new modes, more features and hours of fun gameplay!

[h1]Working On[/h1]

[list]
   [*]Localization (New Languages)
   [*]Info Button: The button that says why it is the answer.
   [*]Guess The Food
   [*]Trade Cards
   [*]Online Multiplayer
   [*]More Questions & Mods
   [*]Categories
[/list]


Thanks for your support,
[b]TRIVIA NIGHT[/b]

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Steam s latest hidden delights
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly wade through Steam’s ever-deepening sewers to find ten sparkling new releases that perhaps have not enjoyed the attention they deserve.

This week: absurdist sports medicine, roguelike vs poker vs match-3, bumblebee simulation and chimp-powered internet. … [visit site to read more]
